jobs.description:
The hiring organization is a respected entity focused on consumer advocacy and policy development. As a medium-sized organization, it is committed to addressing consumer needs through research, policy work, and collaboration with stakeholders.

Jobomschrijving

As a Policy Officer your responsibilities are:

• Analyze and assess consumer policies with a focus on economic perspectives.
• Develop and implement strategies for effective advocacy at the European and international levels.
• Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to advance consumer interests.
• Monitor policy developments and identify opportunities to influence decision-making processes.
• Prepare reports, briefings, and presentations to support policy positions.
• Represent the organization in meetings, events, and consultations with policymakers and other stakeholders.
• Provide expertise on economic aspects of consumer protection and market practices.
• Contribute to the overall objectives of the Marketing & Agency department.

A successful Policy Officer should have:

• A Master's degree in Economics or Business Studies.
• Strong experience in European or international policy and advocacy.
• Proficiency in assessing consumer policy areas, particularly from an economic perspective.
• Excellent communication and analytical skills.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
• A proactive and results-oriented approach to work.
• Excellent level of English both written and verbal, French and Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Animal Health Sales Director - Veterinary - Pharma
jobs.description:
Our client is a Belgian company specialising in the development, registration, marketing and commercialisation of veterinary pharmaceutical products for both livestock and companion animal. The organisation has built a strong reputation through its scientific expertise, in-house R&D laboratory, and regulatory excellence. Operating internationally through a network of manufacturing and distribution partners, the company offers innovative veterinary solutions across multiple continents while maintaining the agility, ownership culture, and entrepreneurial spirit of a growing SME.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Animal Health Sales Manager - Pharmaceutical Products - Veterinary channel, you will have the following responsibilities: 

Business Development - Creation of new partnerships

• Identify new business opportunities and evaluate new potential products for the portfolio.
• Conduct market analysis to identify unmet needs within the Belgian veterinary sector.
• Assess partnerships with pharmaceutical manufacturers and negotiate exclusive distribution opportunities.
• Define product positioning, pricing strategies, and go-to-market plans.
• Prepare and support product launches in collaboration with the sales team.

Field Sales Management 

• Develop and execute the commercial strategy for the Belgian market.
• Lead, motivate, and coach a team of 5 sales representatives covering Belgium.
• Maintain close contact with key stakeholders in the Belgian veterinary market.
• Monitor market trends, competition, and business performance.

As a successful Animal Health Sales Manager - Pharmaceutical Products - Veterinary channel, you will have the following profile:

• Veterinary degree or equivalent in-depth expertise and network within the veterinary industry.
• 10/15 years of experiences in the Animal Health industry.
• Strong knowledge of the Belgian veterinary market and its key stakeholders.
• Proven experience in a commercial, sales management, or business development role.
• Previous experience managing and coaching sales teams.
• Strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach.
• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent in Dutch with a good level of English.

FMCG

• Create and maintain production plans
• Ensure products are available for customer orders and stock
• Monitor production constraints daily and adjust schedules when needed
• Support projects related to new product launches, phase-outs, and process improvements
• Work with different teams to coordinate product launches and discontinuations
• Represent the planning team in internal meetings
• Keep planning data and systems up to date
• Communicate with planning, production, purchasing, and customer service teams to solve planning challenges

• Great communication skills in Dutch, English and French

• Experience in Production Planning 
• Experience within FMCG is a big plus

jobs.occupation: Multilingual Customer Advisor – DE/EN/(NL or FR) in Liège
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about delivering outstanding customer service and fluent in multiple languages? As a Customer Advisor in our Liège-based team, you’ll be the first point of contact for customers, ensuring their needs are met with professionalism and efficiency. You’ll interact with international clients through various channels – calls, emails, and chat – providing accurate, friendly, and timely support.

You will support Satellic customers through different communication channels and provide professional, efficient assistance regarding their requests and issues: handling calls, emails, and chats related to the road toll for freight vehicles in Belgium and, in the future, other projects such as Monizze, Arrive, Fain and verification of on-board documents via the CRM system.

Ready to take the next step in your career? If you have strong language skills, a commitment to delivering excellent service, and thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, we want to hear from you. Apply today and become a valued member of our international customer service team in Liège!

• Strong communication and customer service skills

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

• Upper secondary education completed

• 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in customer service or a related field

• Availability for rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00 (potential for homeworking)

• Full-time availability

jobs.occupation: Operations Coordinator - Dutch & German speaking m/f/d (Callcenteragent/in)
jobs.description:
**Location:**  Ghent

Client confidential

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 

This is us, your new colleagues

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.

This is the job

- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.
- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.
- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.
- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?

- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.
- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.
- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.
- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.
- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.
- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.
- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.

A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...

- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.
- Well-being services
- Restaurant on site
- Opportunity to grow within the company
- Good work life balance
- International environment
- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

• Address customer concerns by executing root cause investigations and offering solutions (replacements, corrective invoices, ...)
• Issue credit/debit memos
• Support inventory management activities

• You're fluent in English and intermediate to proficient in either Russian, French or Arab
• You have a first experience in a similar role
• Upper secondary diploma/high school diploma

In this key role, you will ensure the accurate and timely processing of invoices and payments, maintain compliance with accounting and tax regulations and drive continuous process improvements.

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead, coach, and develop the Accounts Payable team.
• Oversee the end-to-end Accounts Payable process, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
• Coordinate invoice processing, payment runs, and AP-related financial controls.
• Manage monthly closing activities, reconciliations, accruals, and follow-up of outstanding items.
• Ensure compliance with VAT, tax, and internal accounting policies.
• Act as the main point of contact for AP-related matters across multiple stakeholders.
• Identify and implement process improvements, standardization initiatives, and automation opportunities.

• Several years of experience in Accounts Payable within a multinational or complex organization.
• Strong SAP knowledge; experience with SAP S/4HANA is a plus.
• Solid understanding of VAT and accounting regulations.
• Proven experience leading and developing teams.
• Analytical, structured, and detail-oriented.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Interest in process optimization, automation, and digital finance solutions.

Looking for a new challenge in supply chain within an international and forward-thinking organization?

As a Supply Chain Assistant you will support the supply chain team with daily tasks such as:

• Manage material availability and inventory levels to ensure uninterrupted operations. 
• Maintain SAP MRP parameters and follow up on shortages, replenishmen, and planning activities. 
• Coordinate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering and Operations teams to resolve material-related issues. 
• Analyze KPIs and SAP reports to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
• Support process improvement and optimization initiatives for critical materials and supply chain workflows.

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Good knowledge of SAP, MRP planning and inventory management processes.
• Strong Excel and data analysis skills.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills with a proactive and results-oriented mindset.

Our client is a European transport company specialising in the hire of plastic pallets.

Jobomschrijving

Do you enjoy problem-solving, adapting to new situations and communicating with people from different countries? Then we have a great challenge for you!

We are looking for a motivated Customer Service Assistant for an innovative transport company in Schelle (Antwerp) who can communicate fluently in English, Polish and German.

You’ll be a key link within the logistics department. Working with various partners and sites, you’ll ensure that return shipments are collected smoothly, efficiently and on time. No two days are the same: you’ll plan, coordinate, follow up and step in when things don’t go to plan.

Your mission?

To ensure that every collection runs as smoothly as possible. You’ll maintain an overview, liaise with the relevant parties and spot potential issues before they become real problems.

In practical terms, this means that you:

• Plan and organise collections by creating weekly schedules and maintaining contact with the relevant partners and locations.

• Actively track which locations have not yet been contacted and ensure that no collection slips through the net.

• Monitor performance and help devise solutions when a collection does not go to plan.

• Keep customer details up to date, from telephone numbers and email addresses to opening hours and other practical information.

• Continuously look for smart ways to increase the success rate of collections.

Can you tick off the following points? Then you’re the Customer Service we’re looking for!
	
• • You’re multilingual. You communicate fluently in English, Polish and German and feel at ease in an international working environment.	
• Transport and logistics appeal to you. Experience is a bonus, but not essential. Your motivation, eagerness to learn and interest in the sector are just as important.	
• You’re curious and keen to learn. You pick up new information quickly and have an interest in transport and logistics.	
• You like structure. You work in an organised manner and ensure your records are kept clearly, transparently and efficiently.	
• You take the initiative. You don’t always wait for someone to tell you what needs doing, but contribute your own ideas and aren’t afraid to take action.	
• You’re confident and self-assured. Even when things don’t go to plan, you stay calm, focus on solutions and aren’t afraid to make decisions.	
• You’re a real team player. You enjoy working with others, help colleagues where needed and bring a positive vibe to the team with your energy.	
• You have your own transport and can get to Schelle with ease.

Are you ready to take the next step in your career as a Technical Operator? As a vital member of our team, you'll work with cutting-edge machinery to produce high-quality steel profiles. You'll become an expert in operating our state-of-the-art equipment, ensuring that production runs smoothly and efficiently.

Every day, you'll engage with complex and simple finishing machines including conventional and CNC-controlled systems like sawing machines, drilling machines, and laser cutters. Your keen attention to detail and commitment to quality will ensure that every component meets our high standards.

We're looking for motivated and eager-to-learn individuals. Apply now to join a supportive environment where your skills will be valued and developed!

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Knowledge of pneumatics and ability to install tubes and test movements

• Passion for technology and a team-oriented mindset

• Eagerness to learn with a conscientious and responsible approach

• Strict adherence to safety rules and flexibility in working hours

An international manufacturing organization is seeking a senior finance leader to support operational performance, profitability enhancement and strategic decision-making across a complex industrial footprint.

This highly visible role combines financial leadership, operational analysis and performance management, while partnering with senior stakeholders to drive sustainable business results.

The successful candidate will operate at the crossroads of finance and operations, providing meaningful insight, challenge and support to business leaders within a dynamic and evolving industrial environment.

Jobomschrijving

Head of Plant Controlling - Europe

You will play a central role in monitoring and driving operational performance, helping business leaders translate industrial activities into measurable financial outcomes.

Acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, you will contribute to both short-term performance delivery and long-term value creation initiatives.

Key responsibilities include:

• Driving financial and operational performance management across manufacturing activities
• Leading budgeting, forecasting and strategic planning processes for industrial operations
• Identifying opportunities to improve profitability, productivity and resource allocation
• Analyzing cost structures, operational efficiencies and key performance drivers
• Supporting business leaders through data-driven recommendations and robust financial insights
• Challenging assumptions and influencing decision-making through fact-based analysis
• Developing and enhancing performance management tools, reporting frameworks and financial governance practices
• Supporting investment evaluations, business cases and transformation initiatives
• Monitoring operational risks and ensuring appropriate financial controls are in place
• Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening business performance
• Collaborating with finance and operational teams across multiple locations and functions.

Head of Plant Controlling - Europe

We are looking for a seasoned finance professional who combines strong analytical capabilities with a genuine understanding of industrial operations.

You bring:

• Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering or Business Administration
• Strong leadership skills
• Significant experience in industrial finance, controlling or performance management within a manufacturing environment
• Strong understanding of cost management, profitability analysis and operational performance measurement
• Experience operating in international and matrix organizations
• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and challenge constructively
• Strong business acumen coupled with excellent analytical skills
• Ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations
• Experience supporting operational and strategic decision-making
• Excellent communication and presentation skills
• Fluency in English with knowledge of French and/or Dutch
• Open to travel occasionally.

We are looking for a technically minded operator who enjoys practical work and wants to learn new things. You will operate and monitor various advanced machines:

• Tricantors: Separating oil from other materials – high-quality machines that require a delicate touch to operate.
• Shredder: Reducing the size of filter cloths.

In addition, you will remain calm and focused when problems arise while multiple machines are running.

Working hours

Monday - Friday: 08:00 PM - 04:00 AM

Profile

• You're not afraid to get your hands dirty
• Technical profile is compulsory
• Good knowledge of Dutch, French or English
• Experience as operator or higher education is a plus
• Experience operating Manitou and Komatsu cranes is a plus
• A stable CV
